topic: Organic outbound outreach strategy for Assistedly.ai targeting sandwich-generation women in Massachusetts

deliverables.description: Comprehensive 323-line strategic document synthesizing Boardy.ai, Superhuman, Clubhouse, and healthcare AI outreach models into a 7-part framework for Assistedly.ai. Includes platform analysis, audience deep-dive for MA sandwich-generation women, Maggie/Pat persona creation, 30-60-90 day implementation checklist, measurement framework, growth flywheel diagram, and risk mitigation.

414-line tactical playbook with 12 high-intent posts identified via Firecrawl, verbatim comment templates for Pat, DM follow-up scripts, Maggie SMS handoffs, 5 platform user profiles, anti-spam checklist, response priority ranking, and ToS compliance amendments.

358-line platform Terms of Service compliance analysis covering Reddit User Agreement, Quora ToS/AUP, AgingCare.com ToS, Facebook Community Standards, and Nextdoor Member Agreement. Includes compliance decision matrix, cross-platform bot activity insights, amended playbook requirements, and legal risk summary.

key_strategic_decisions.rationale: LinkedIn is low-trust for demographic (women 50s, sandwich generation, MA caregivers); cold phone calls trigger broker anxiety. Replaced with high-trust channels: Facebook Groups, Reddit r/AgingParents, Quora answers, Mass. state/community partnerships.

key_strategic_decisions.decision: Created two-layer trust model: Pat (human) + Maggie (AI)
key_strategic_decisions.rationale: Community members trust human peer first; AI disclosure in SMS builds radical transparency. Pat never mentions AI or Assistedly.ai brand in public; Maggie always discloses AI status in first text.

key_strategic_decisions.decision: Disregarded website signals for outbound discovery
key_strategic_decisions.rationale: Per explicit user instruction. Discovery limited to four warm-touch signals: Public Ask, Trusted Handoff, Peer Bridge, Event Connection. No pixel-based retargeting.

key_strategic_decisions.decision: Mandatory lurk-and-contribute period before any tool promotion
key_strategic_decisions.rationale: Platform community norms and anti-spam systems punish immediate promotional behavior. Minimums: Reddit (15+ genuine comments, 500+ karma), AgingCare (20+ comments over 6 weeks), Quora (1 month, 2-3 answers/week), Facebook Groups (4 weeks of reactions/comments), Nextdoor (10+ non-commercial helpful replies).

key_strategic_decisions.decision: Strict anti-spam architecture for first messages
key_strategic_decisions.rationale: Name shared context within 5 words, lead with specific free value, disclose AI status honestly, one-word opt-out, no cold messages, max two follow-ups, no purchased lists, local MA phone number only.

what_other_bots_are_excelling_at.description: Every successful organic outreach bot follows human-in-the-loop model
specific_examples: Claude Routines for Reddit monitoring + drafting; human manually posts
ReplyAgent.ai model: AI finds threads → drafts → human edits → manual post
Quora AI agents that draft answers; human rewrites 60%+ before posting
Facebook Group AI monitors for keywords; human crafts personalized response
Long Game AI: tracks conversation history, builds relationship over weeks, never pitches in first 3-5 interactions
what_other_bots_are_excelling_at.why_it_works: Platforms' anti-spam systems detect and ban fully automated behavior. Human-in-the-loop creates authentic engagement patterns that evade detection while scaling output.

compliance_metrics: AI disclosure rate 100% in all DMs
